verdict.rationale: Sketch's docs confirm non-destructive boolean operations (Union/Subtract/Intersect/Difference) and shape styling (fill, border, shadows), and the Mac app is described as where you 'build interfaces' and design, supporting professional vector work. However, there is no explicit documentation of pen/path editing tools or precise alignment/snapping features, and one community comment notes Sketch's vector editing is comparatively 'buggier' than a competitor's. Missing for 10: explicit pen tool/path editing documentation, alignment/distribution tooling evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of vector editing precision.
